items.quote: - "promote-next and promote-now are refused with 422 GateNotCalibratedError(verb) directly after the not-built check, before alias validation, trace resolution and any Ledger construction, for every all_wirings() arm with an identical message apart from the verb; no ledger.db, ledger.db-wal or ledger.db-shm is created (LEDG-08, D-04, LEDG-06(b) gate leg)"

- "POST /trace/resolve accepts the debug flag only as a JSON boolean: the strings 'yes', 'true', '1' and the number 1 each give a 422 validation error whose body carries none of run_id, wiring_id, wiring_instance_hash, arm_id or nodes; true returns the full record and false the reduced one (LEDG-09, D-10)"

- "On the query path, capability selectors ['writes_artifact'], ['writes_graph'], ['writes_vector'] and ['writes_kv'] each refuse with UnsatisfiableSelectorError, so writes_artifact never selects naive and no writes_* selects hipporag (LEDG-10, D-11)"

- "A wiring node whose kind differs from its registered Part.kind is reported by parse_wiring as a violation with code 'kind-mismatch', a pointer ending '/kind', and a message naming the node id, the wiring's kind and the part's kind; parse_wiring reports and never raises (LEDG-11, D-12)"

- "default_registry() holds no admitted part that no selector reaches: every key whose part has an admission is a component of some all_wirings() wiring or of a corpus-ingest/corpus-delete wiring of a WIRING_NAMES family (LEDG-12, D-13)"

- "engine._corpus_wiring loads through wirings.resolve.load_wiring(family, variant=f'corpus-{operation}') and maps FileNotFoundError to NoWritePathForModalityError (422); the engine's own wirings-root constant is gone, so the corpus path layout is defined only in resolve.py (LEDG-13, D-14)"

- "The same test asserts that the PartRegistry and default_registry docstrings refer to keys() for the contents and state no part count, that the resolve.py module docstring names all_wirings, load_wiring and wiring_for_name, and that the selectors.py module docstring keeps all_wirings() (LEDG-14, SEAM-16)"
